title: OpenSIP exploratory quality envelope (D13 draft)
description: Draft for D13 (docs/implementation/m3/analysis-quality/PLAN.md:419-425, :535). Exploratory, never promoted, never a G13 input. References unchanged RS3 observations by digest; RS3 itself is not changed. Proportions and bounds are integer millionths (no floats; canonical bytes per docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/canonical.py). Design: docs/implementation/m3/harness/DESIGN.md (r4) sections 11-12. Cross-row invariants a schema cannot express are checked by the envelope validator (DESIGN.md r4 section 9.5): exactly one final batch per key; batchId equals the SHA-256 of its canonical key tuple; every q6 batch has exactly one batchObservations row and, for each warmup and measured slot, exactly one operationalRecords row or a record-missing reason on that slot; no duplicate (batchId, slot); no orphan record or observation; at most one slotReasons row per slot, and every operational record missing from a required slot listed as record-missing on that slot; per measured slot and quantity, a value is null if and only if a reason the DESIGN QD-27 table maps to that quantity is present (record-missing and record-invalid null no numeric sample; run-failed and timeout null all four; inventory and own-counter reasons null ownHighWaterSumBytes and peakRssBytes only); the median non-null exactly when all seven elapsed values are, and the maximum exactly when all seven peaks are; phaseTimingsPresent true exactly when every measured slot has a valid record, and phaseAbsenceReason null exactly then; population counts summing (corpus = sampled + unlabelled, sampled = settled + pending, settled = true + false + unclear).

declaration.const: Exploratory measurement. Not G13 evidence, not qualification evidence, never promoted. A qualification run re-executes from scratch on the D12 lanes against the held-out set.

assumption.const: Families are treated as independent draws from the population of repositories the claim is about; T2 is purposely selected, not randomly sampled.
